speaker: Foggy
text: This is Foggy from your care team calling for your recovery check-in.

speaker: Patient
text: Just got settled on the couch.

speaker: Foggy
text: On a scale from 0 to 10, how's your pain right now?

speaker: Patient
text: It was worse this morning before I iced it.

speaker: Foggy
text: Did you take your acetaminophen, the 1,000 milligrams, at 6:00 this morning?

speaker: Patient
text: Yeah, took that one with breakfast.

speaker: Patient
text: Ah, no, I forgot the aspirin.

speaker: Foggy
text: Go ahead and take it after this call.

speaker: Foggy
text: I put it as missed for now.

speaker: Foggy
text: You can change it when you do take it.

speaker: Foggy
text: Did you need any oxycodone today?

speaker: Patient
text: No, the pain's been manageable without it.

speaker: Foggy
text: Any new numbness, tingling, or color change in your leg or foot?

speaker: Foggy
text: Any falls since you got home?

speaker: Patient
text: Almost tripped over my dog Niko, but I caught myself.

speaker: Foggy
text: After this call, would you like me to send the transcript to your care team?

speaker: Foggy
text: Anything else I can help you with?

speaker: Patient
text: When can I start showering again?

speaker: Foggy
text: Your care plan says you can shower 48 hours after surgery with the waterproof dressing on, just no soaking in a bath for four weeks.

speaker: Foggy
text: Keep that leg up and I'll check in again tomorrow.
